# QS-CFW-5042-83 - Quality specification - valve body CFW-5042-83 (F316)

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-5042-83

Scope
This specification defines the minimum quality requirements for valve body CFW-5042-83 (CFW-5042-83) forged in F316 material at Plant P3. It covers acceptance criteria for hardness, critical bore geometry, and maximum forging weight for material release and final inspection prior to machining.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | 33-38 HRC | Material accepted if hardness within range |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.06 mm | Bore must measure within tolerance after final machining operations |
| Maximum forging weight | 77.3 kg | Forging rejected if weight exceeds maximum |

Inspection method
Hardness: Verify hardness using a calibrated Rockwell test instrument for HRC scale on representative surfaces of each heat lot. Record readings and ensure values fall within 33-38 HRC. Use surface preparation appropriate for Rockwell testing.

Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or coordinate measuring device. Ensure the measured value is within ±0.06 mm of specified nominal. Document measured value and instrument used.

Weight: Determine forging weight on a calibrated scale capable of accommodating the forging form. Confirm that as-forged weight does not exceed 77.3 kg. Record scale identification and measured weight.

Nonconformance handling
If any characteristic fails to meet the specified requirement in the Requirements table, isolate the affected material and hold it from further processing. Notify Quality and Production leads and generate a nonconformance record. Disposition options include rework to meet specification or rejection per plant procedures. Final disposition must be approved by authorized Quality personnel before release for machining or shipment.
